newsitem.title: USA: US official says China has work to do in WTO bid.
newsitem.headline: US official says China has work to do in WTO bid.

text.p: China has a lot of work to do in its bid to join the World Trade Organization, Deputy U.S. Trade Representative Jeffrey Lang said on Wednesday.
"They need to do some homework," Lang told reporters after testifying to a House Ways and Means trade subcommittee. "They know the homework they need to do. Let's see what they come up with."

U.S. officials have said that Chinese officials in recent discussions on Beijing's bid to join the World Trade Organization have indicated they are willing to agree to some tough reforms, including opening markets up to more imports, sought by the United States and others.
Officials have said privately that they are waiting to see China's offers in writing during upcoming negotiations in Geneva.
"We've got a lot we need from China," Lang told reporters. "They are starting from a pretty low base."
He said that Chinese officials have to discuss their commitment to the basic obligations of the WTO and offer an attractive market access package.
